text:
Maria Nguyen: Heads-up — NovusHealth dedicated pool goes live next Tue morning. Need to lock quota plan, autoscale policy, and a 2h load-test window. Who can own what?
Ajay Patel: I can take autoscale policy + runbook updates. Need their expected concurrent RPS and typical prompt length distribution.
Maria Nguyen: I'll pull usage profile from the onboarding workbook. They said spike to ~220 RPS for embedding calls and sustained 60 RPS for chat gen.
Tom Rivera: For the load test I can script a k6 scenario. Prefer Wed 09:00-11:00 PT for minimal customer impact. Is that ok?
Leah Chen: Wed works for us for enablement walkthrough. I'll do a 30m ops handoff after the test.
Priya Singh: Renewal is September — this onboarding is critical. If we see >2 incident pages during bring-up, that becomes a risk flag to flag AM and AE.
Ajay Patel: Draft autoscale policy suggestion:
```json
{"min_replicas":2, "max_replicas":10, "scale_out_threshold":0.75, "scale_in_threshold":0.30, "stabilization_window_seconds":120}
```
Tom Rivera: k6 command I'll run:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m --out influxdb=http://influx:8086/loadtests scripts/novuschat.js
```
Maria Nguyen: Can we also pre-warm KV cache for their common prefixes? They have high prefix reuse.
Ajay Patel: Yes — we'll upload the top 5k tokens prefixes list to the caching service before traffic. Can someone export that list?
Maria Nguyen: On it, sending the CSV to eng-ml by EOD.
Priya Singh: I'll prep the renewal note and include performance targets: p95 latency < 350ms for chat gen, token cost < $0.003/token target.
Leah Chen: For enablement, I'll prepare a short runbook and an FAQ (2 pages). Also schedule a 1:1 with Novus SREs after the handoff.
Tom Rivera: Post-test steps: 1) upload k6 metrics, 2) run smoke through canary route, 3) validate token accounting.
RedwoodOpsBot: Reminder — reserved pool provisioning scheduled for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Automated quota allocation will run at 01:30 UTC.
Ajay Patel: Good catch. I'll coordinate with infra to ensure GPU nodes are up by 01:50 UTC and will watch the provisioning logs.
Maria Nguyen: Owner list: Ajay (autoscale + infra), Tom (load test), Leah (enablement + handoff), Priya (account health + renewal). I'll run weekly status updates in this thread.
Priya Singh: Can we add a quick postmortem template if anything degrades during initial 48h? I'll draft one.
Tom Rivera: Noted. Also flagging: if we hit OOM on 16k context, fallback to 8k quantized variant and route non-critical requests to pooled region-east.
Maria Nguyen: Thanks team — pls react with :thumbsup: when you confirm your owners.
Ajay Patel: :thumbsup:
Tom Rivera: :thumbsup:
Leah Chen: :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
